jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Description
Working in Product means making bold decisions with the data you have. You're the type that always asks, “Is there a better way?” From product managers to designers to researchers, the people who thrive here are strategic by nature, curious by default, and comfortable sailing without a full map. So if you challenge assumptions and know how to bring multiple stakeholders together, the Fiverr Product team might be your place.
 Fiverr’s design team is growing, and we’re hiring a Senior Product Designer who will shape how millions of buyers and talent experience Fiverr, with a strong focus on mobile. You’ll work in a team that treats AI as a daily design partner, not a side experiment: you’ll use tools like Claude to research, explore, prototype, and ship faster, and help the rest of the team do the same.
 You’re a leading figure without needing a title. You raise the bar through your craft, your clarity, and the way you bring people along.
What am I going to do?
• Own end-to-end design for key mobile experiences (iOS, Android, mobile web), from problem framing and research to polished, shipped UI.
• Work AI-first: use Claude and similar tools across your process (synthesizing research, generating and pressure-testing options, building working prototypes, writing specs and edge cases). Share what works so the team learns with you.
• Lead by influence: set direction in your area, run design critiques, mentor designers, and be the person PMs, engineers, and peers want in the room.
• Partner closely with PMs, engineers, researchers, and content designers. Communicate early and often, share work in progress, and make decisions visible.
• Identify pain points across the full user journey and solve them with hypotheses, experiments, and data.
• Improve existing flows and craft new ones that feel native to mobile: thumb-friendly, fast, clear, and accessible.
• Build and evolve Penta, our design system, by contributing components, patterns, and feedback that keep our products consistent.
• Prototype and iterate in the open, from Figma to coded prototypes, until the experience is right.
• Work with engineering through implementation to make sure what ships matches the design intent.
Requirements
• 6+ years as a Product Designer (UX and UI) in consumer, marketplace, or SaaS products, with a strong portfolio of shipped mobile work.
• Deep mobile craft: platform conventions (iOS HIG, Material), gestures, responsive behavior, performance, and accessibility.
• Hands-on experience using AI in your design workflow (Claude, Cursor, v0, or similar), and a real point of view on where it helps and where it doesn’t.
• Strong communication: you explain your thinking clearly, give and receive feedback well, and keep stakeholders aligned without friction.
• A team-player mindset: you share credit, lift others, and care about the team’s output as much as your own.
• Experience leading without authority: driving alignment, mentoring peers, or influencing product direction.
• Strong proficiency in Figma, plus working knowledge of front-end concepts (component libraries, tokens, Lottie, handoff).
• Analytical thinking, attention to detail, and comfort with ambiguity and complex, fast-moving environments
• Comfort working with Agile tools (Jira, Monday, etc.).
 Nice to have
 • Experience designing marketplace, two-sided, or transactional products.
• Quantitative and qualitative research experience, or close work with UX researchers.
• Experience with design systems at scale.
• Coded prototyping (React, SwiftUI) or vibe-coding experience.
• A degree in Design, HCI, Cognitive or Applied Psychology, or a related field.
 ***include a link to your portfolio. For one or two mobile projects, tell us about your role, your decisions, and how AI was part of your process.
Equal opportunities
At Fiverr, we know that talent has no single face. We welcome talent from everywhere and everyone because it makes everything we build better. Need accommodations? Just ask. And if this role excites you but you don't tick every box, apply anyway. The best people rarely fit the mold exactly.

AI is changing what we build - our product is moving toward AI agents and AI-driven insights on top of the most comprehensive digital dataset in the world. It's changing how we build it - research, prototyping, design systems, and handoff to engineering all work differently now. And it's changing the tools we use, including the ones we're building for ourselves. The field is reshaping as we go and we adjust with it. We're looking for someone who finds that exciting rather than exhausting.
 So, what will you be doing all day? 
 Your role as a Product Designer at Similarweb means your daily responsibilities may include:
• Owning meaningful areas of our product - from research and ideation through user flows, prototyping, testing, microcopy, and all the way to launch.
• Turning dense, complex data into experiences people can actually read, trust, and act on.
• Designing AI-powered experiences: agentic flows, prompt- and conversation-driven interfaces, and AI-generated insights. That means designing for the hard parts too - non-deterministic outputs, trust and explainability, keeping a human in the loop, and what the experience looks like when the model gets it wrong.
• Using AI throughout your own process to get from idea to something real, fast - prototyping working flows instead of static screens, exploring more directions before committing, and putting real interactions in front of stakeholders and users early.
• Building, not only specifying. Some of what you design you'll take considerably further yourself, using AI tools to produce working features that engineering reviews before release. Knowing where that line sits - what's ready to ship and what needs a second pair of eyes - is part of the craft now.
• Maintaining and evolving our design system - components, variables, tokens, patterns, and guidelines - so quality and consistency hold as the product scales, and so anyone building against it (designer, engineer, or AI tool) ends up with something that looks and behaves like Similarweb.
• Using quantitative and qualitative data tools to research, track, and measure design flows.
• Communicating with stakeholders, including executives, on design decisions, progress, and outcomes.
• Bringing back what you learn. New tools, new workflows, better ways of working - we test them, and we adopt what works.
 This is the perfect job for someone with: 
• 3+ years of experience in product design , with a proven track record of delivering digital SaaS products .
• Strong data visualization instincts - you're at home in dense analytical interfaces: time series, benchmarks, funnels, and tables people actually use.
• A strong portfolio that demonstrates your design skills, process, and impact on business objectives .
• Hands-on experience working with AI as part of your day-to-day design practice - prototyping, exploration, research, or production work. We care much more about how you actually use it than about which tools you name.

• Design systems experience - you're fluent in Figma libraries (components, variants, variables, tokens) and know how to keep design and code in sync with engineers. Having built one is a plus, not a requirement.

 Advantages: 
• Experience designing AI-native features - agents, copilots, chat, or generative interfaces - a significant advantage.
• Experience on complex SaaS or analytics platforms.
• Experience writing structured context files for AI tools (such as design.md, AGENTS.md, or custom prompt rules) so both people and AI models can follow them.
• Experience designing products for digital marketers, or in competitive intelligence, e-commerce, web analytics, or the mobile app ecosystem.
 **At Similarweb, collaborating with our colleagues in the office creates a more connected, unified culture. Our best work is a product of our face-to-face collaboration, with the ability to work partially from home.**
 Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber: 
 Manage data at scale. You'll design for data sets most designers never get near, and the best companies in the world will use what you ship to make real decisions.
 Lead the AI era. You'll build with AI technology at a company engineered for the future - and in a design team actively working out what this craft becomes next, rather than waiting to be told.
 Own your projects. The trust, autonomy and freedom to do your best

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer who designs products and builds the tools that change how design gets done. 
 This role has two halves. You will own the design of a core area of the Optibus platform, end to end, at the same craft bar as everyone else on the team. Alongside that, you will build the agents, skills and internal tools that reshape how our whole design team works., and prove them on your own product area first. 
 We think these belong together. Someone rebuilding the workflow should be living inside it every day, so what they build survives contact with real product work. If you have been quietly automating your own design process and wishing it were your actual job, this is that job. 
 We already have an AI agent in the product. It works, it is early, and it is nowhere near what it should be. How far it goes, and what it grows into, is genuinely open. The designer who understands agents best will have a real voice in answering that. 
 This is an individual contributor role. You will mentor, and you will change how the team works, but you will not manage people. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Own a core product area: Take full design ownership of a significant surface, from discovery through shipped experience and beyond launch, working directly with product and engineering. 
• Build the agentic design toolchain: Create and maintain the skills, agents and commands the design team uses day to day, covering the path from ticket to reviewable prototype. 
• Prototype in working code: Move from problem statement to a clickable, testable artifact quickly by orchestrating agents to do the building while you review, steer and cut. 
• Orchestrate agents through a product cycle: Decide what gets delegated, what stays human, and where the human gate sits, then write it down so others can repeat it. 
• Make new ways of working stick: Run the rituals that turn tools into habits. Prototyping sprints, office hours, pairing, internal demos, and the documentation behind them. Retire what does not earn its place. 
• Keep us honest about quality: Define how we know an agent output is good, build lightweight checks for what you ship, and tell us plainly when the agentic path is worse than the manual one. 
 As a core team member, you will: 
 • User-Centric Design: Deeply understand and address the needs and pain points of Optibus users 
• Ship real product on your area, not only tooling and experiments 
• Collaborate with product managers and engineers to make sure designs are feasible and meet the needs of all stakeholders 
• Help other designers adopt new ways of working, through pairing, demos and documentation 
• Tackle design challenges with creativity and a solutions-oriented mindset
Requirements
• 6+ years of experience designing a complex system or platform. 
• Strong portfolio: A comprehensive portfolio showing your design process, problem-solving skills, and the impact of your work. (Must include link to portfolio) 
• We are looking for someone who has demonstrated leadership in transforming how design teams work 
• Enough comfort with code to steer and correct what agents produce. HTML, CSS, JavaScript or TypeScript. You do not need to be an engineer. 
• Excellent communication and writing. Prompts, specs and documentation are a big part of the interface of this job. 
• (Bonus) Workflow orchestration experience: n8n, MCP servers, scripting, CI. 
• (Bonus) Experience designing AI or agentic product experiences. 
• (Bonus) Public work: a repo, a plugin, a set of skills, or a written point of view on agentic design. 
 What We Offer: 
 • Opportunity to work on challenging and meaningful projects that drive real impact on the world. 
• Collaborative and supportive team environment. 
• Competitive salary and benefits package. 
• Flexible working arrangements. 
 About Optibus: 
 Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 8,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike. 
 Why Join Optibus? 
 • Be part of a company revolutionizing public transportation with cutting-edge technology. 
• Collaborate with global teams passionate about sustainability and innovation. 
• Enjoy a dynamic and inclusive workplace culture that values growth and creativity. 
• We offer a hybrid work environment, with employees expected to be in the office 3 days a week. The remaining days can be worked remotely to support work-life balance and flexibility. 
 ﻿Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. Description
Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, helping security teams focus on what truly matters. With eBPF-powered sensors, agentless cloud posture capabilities, real-time threat protection, code security, and AI security, Upwind provides a unified approach to protecting modern cloud environments. 
 We are looking for an experienced Product Designer to join our Product Experience team and help shape complex, technical security products used by security, cloud, and engineering teams. 
 This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys diving into complex domains, understanding technical concepts and workflows, and turning them into clear, intuitive, and scalable product experiences. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, customers, and the broader design team — owning projects from early discovery and problem definition through design, implementation, and post-launch iteration. 
 Experience designing cybersecurity, developer tools, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, code-related products, or other complex B2B technical platforms is a strong advantage. 
 Responsibilities 
 • Own End-to-End Product Design: Lead design initiatives from problem definition and discovery through UX strategy, detailed interaction design, implementation, and post-launch iteration. 
• Simplify Complex Technical Workflows: Translate complex security, cloud, code, data, and infrastructure concepts into intuitive and scalable user experiences. 
• Partner with Product & Engineering: Work closely with Product Managers and Engineers to understand problems, challenge assumptions, shape requirements, and define the right product experience. 
• Drive Customer-Centered Design: Engage directly with customers through interviews, usability testing, design reviews, and feedback sessions to validate decisions and uncover real user needs. 
• Use Data to Improve the Product: Leverage product data, customer feedback, and usage patterns to evaluate released experiences, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the product. 
• Build Consistent Platform Experiences: Contribute to and evolve Upwind’s design system and UX patterns, ensuring consistency across a broad and growing product platform. 
• Partner Through Implementation: Work closely with Engineering throughout development, from design handoff through QA and release, ensuring a high-quality implementation. 
• Leverage AI in the Design Process: Use AI tools to accelerate research, exploration, prototyping, content creation, and product thinking, and continuously explore new ways AI can improve the design workflow. 
• Raise the Design Bar: Bring strong product thinking, craft, and design judgment to critiques and discussions, helping elevate the overall quality of Upwind’s product experience.
Requirements
• 4+ years of experience as a Product Designer, ideally working on complex B2B or enterprise products. 
• A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, complex workflows, information architecture, and thoughtful interaction design — not just visual execution. 
• Proven ability to independently lead complex design projects, from ambiguous problems and early exploration through shipped solutions. 
• Strong UX and product thinking, with the ability to understand complex systems and turn them into simple, clear, and effective experiences. 
• Experience working closely with Product and Engineering teams in a fast-paced product environment. 
• Strong proficiency in Figma and experience working with and contributing to design systems. 
• Experience conducting customer research, usability testing, and translating insights into product decisions. 
• Hands-on experience using AI tools as part of the design workflow — for research, exploration, prototyping, content generation, or accelerating design and product thinking. 
• Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly articulate the reasoning behind design decisions. 
• Experience in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, DevOps, code security, or other highly technical products is a strong advantage. 
• Technical curiosity and a strong AI mindset, with the ability to quickly learn new concepts, terminology, workflows, and user personas, and adopt new tools and ways of working.
